properties.description: Every presented data byte matches the ordered accepted prefix or justified zero padding, regardless of sink ready; unaccepted inputs cannot justify output.
Presented last indications match the clamped frame boundary, supporting streaming prefixes and truncation.
Presented headers match completed accepted frames in order, with exact lengths and flags. Header and data consumption advance independently.
Blocked data and header channels preserve valid and enabled payloads until transfer or reset.
Reset cancels epoch obligations and clears response valids without clearing earlier alarms. Meaningful unknowns, frame-length overflow and bounded scoreboard exhaustion cannot establish success.

The final-post marker combinationally checks that input frames and both response channels are drained, with no source or response valid and at least 32 ready-high reset-low no-offer edges. The externally required 128-edge final-tail qualification remains an evaluator prerequisite; this check does not claim unbounded liveness.
